values.review_scope: Exact core authority-protocol source, legacy PolisCommand closure, focused three-voter tests, issue-owned proof/evidence, typed issue truth, and absence of downstream side effects.
review_prompts: Can any public constructor, caller signer, leader, harness, or one voter mint an endorsement or VerifiedAuthorityOperation token?

Does production PrepareAuthority match the state-held verified route cut's exact polis id, membership epoch, authority membership, and boot generations, including negative OpenRaft submissions for relabeled polis and epoch?
Does the private artifact view retain byte-identical committed signed bytes only for sealed #199/#200/#203 consumers without replacement or digest-only reconstruction?

Can only an exact finalized continuity-transfer variant produce the separate sealed #210 projection with wrong consumer, variant, lineage, checkpoint handle, and bundle handle denied before source access?
Does replicated apply consume only committed deterministic time, membership, and artifact evidence, returning a pending response with no token after valid finalize?

Does runtime reconciliation use only state-held local voter identity, deterministic publication root, and configured checkpoint authority, rejecting fake node, root, checkpoint authority, retry, rollback, and one-voter-for-another publication?
Are the actual endorsement signature fields stated exactly, with committed prepare index and finalization time bound while the actual finalize apply index is separately verified and recorded?
Are all legacy direct authority commands retired or versioned fail-closed across apply, log replay, and snapshot restore?
Does the validator independently enforce the exact ordered forty-seven names, results, and canonical marker hashes, including substitution and reorder rejection in full and shallow history?
